Generative ‌Adversarial Networks (GANs): ‍These models consist of ‍two competing neural networks: a generator ‌that‍ creates new data and a ‍discriminator that tries to​ distinguish between real and generated data. this adversarial training process pushes both networks to improve, resulting in increasingly realistic outputs.
